text: Three of them across the road. One is holding a stop sign like a shield.

choices.label: Pay the toll
choices.text: They wave you through without a word.

choices.label: Run it
choices.text: Metal on metal.
choices.failText: The stop sign goes through the window.

choices.label: Talk
choices.text: One of them used to drive this route. He gives you what he can spare.

text: A line of cars, nose to tail, doors open. Abandoned in a hurry a long time ago.

choices.label: Siphon what's left
choices.text: Four litres, and it barely smells off.
choices.failText: Something was living in the third car.

choices.label: Search the cabins
choices.text: Somebody's glovebox stash.
choices.failText: You cut your hand on the glass.

choices.label: Keep moving
choices.text: You don't look in the back seats.

text: Smoke under an overpass. A woman waves — both hands, slowly, so you can see they're empty.

choices.label: Stop and trade
choices.text: She has antibiotics and no appetite for them.

choices.label: Stop and rest
choices.text: First fire you've sat at in a while.

choices.label: Drive past
choices.text: She stops waving before you're out of sight.

text: A windmill still turning over a cattle trough. The trough is dry. The pipe is not.

choices.label: Work the pump
choices.text: Rusty at first, then clear.
choices.failText: The handle comes off in your hands and takes some skin with it.

choices.label: Fill everything you have
choices.text: An hour in the sun, and every container full.

choices.label: Move on
choices.text: You are not thirsty enough yet. Yet.

text: The air over the road has gone liquid. Nothing has moved out there for hours.

choices.label: Push through the afternoon
choices.text: You make good distance and pay for it.

choices.label: Wait for dark
choices.text: You lose half a day and get some of yourself back.

text: A tanker on its side, a mile off the road. It would be a long walk.

choices.label: Walk out to it
choices.text: Seven litres and a working siphon hose.
choices.failText: It's dry, and the walk back is worse than the walk out.

choices.label: Leave it
choices.text: Somebody else's gamble.

text: The road ahead is under half a hillside.

choices.label: Clear a path
choices.text: Two hours of moving rock. You get through.

choices.label: Take the logging track
choices.text: It rejoins the road eventually.
choices.failText: It does not rejoin the road. You lose ground getting back.

text: The temperature drops the moment the sun goes behind the ridge.

choices.label: Burn fuel for heat
choices.text: Expensive warmth. You sleep.

choices.label: Ride it out
choices.text: You shiver through it and wake up whole.
choices.failText: You wake up worse than you went to sleep.

text: Somebody has stacked cairns along the last mile. Hundreds of them. Each has a name scratched into the top stone.

choices.label: Add one
choices.text: You find a flat stone and a nail. It takes a while to decide on the name.

choices.label: Read them
choices.text: You recognise none of them, which is its own kind of relief.

choices.label: Don't stop
choices.text: You keep your eyes on the road.

text: Something under the hood lets go with a sound you feel through the pedals.

choices.label: Fix it properly
choices.text: Half a day upside down in the engine bay. It holds.

choices.label: Bodge it
choices.text: It holds. Somehow.
choices.failText: It holds for six miles, then does it again, worse.

text: Someone is sitting at the roadside, not trying to flag you down. That's what makes you stop.

choices.label: Give them meds
choices.text: They give you what's in their pack. It's more than you gave them.

choices.label: Give them water
choices.text: They drink half and hand the rest back.

choices.label: Drive on
choices.text: You watch them in the mirror for longer than you meant to.

text: A plastic drum buried at the base of a mile marker, the lid a foot under.

choices.label: Dig it out
choices.text: Somebody planned for a journey they never made.

choices.label: Leave it for the next one
choices.text: You rebury the lid and mark the post.
